_meta.evidence_rule: No season or topic is justified by a search-volume or trend figure (D-19 / F-15). Each exists because it answers a question a buyer of the verified five products can actually ask, answerable from the verified register. Seasons follow the US calendar because the marketplace is amazon.com (settings.marketplace).
_meta.last_change: 2026-11-20 (arena/644d217b-prod2): two long-form pieces registered in the thermometer and air-fryer clusters; they carry an argument rather than a checklist and are tracked as SG-45. 2026-11-20 (arena/44af3083-prod2): queue slot 1 shipped early as guide-preheat-shake.html (moved to `shipped`); guide-turkey-done.html added to the holiday-hosting desk and the thermometers cluster for the 2026-11-26 US Thanksgiving window (seasonal framing only, D-19). 2026-11-20 (arena/2adc150a-prod2): sale-week insert guide-sale-week.html published in the holiday-hosting season lane and added to both clusters (decision D-P25 — same ahead-of-cadence precedent as the gifting guide, D-P20); queue untouched. 2026-11-20 (arena/b3089214-prod2): third long read registered (article-leftovers-reheat.html) from the FSIS leftovers factsheet read the same day; slot 1 of the queue is filled on main, so this one is an addition, not a slot claim.

cadence.rule: Each new guide is added to data registers, to the sitemap and to the RSS feed by the same build. A guide publishes only with its sourced facts and its 'what we could not verify' block. The next topic is chosen from measured queries only after the SG-06 gate (Search Console + hosted endpoint + 14 days of events); until then the queue order is editorial.
